{"consolidated_memory":"**OFF-BY-ONE CENT BUGS IN billing/invoice_totals.py (Two Separate Occasions)**

**File & Component:** billing/invoice_totals.py (billing side)
**Common Symptom:** Off-by-one cent discrepancies in the totals calculator
**Common Signal:** One cent gap in reconciliation report
**Common Repro:** Total an invoice with three prorated lines

---

**OCCASION 1: 2026-04-30**
- **Trigger:** Problem appeared only when input list was empty
- **Root Cause:** Clock skew between two hosts
- **Measured Outcome:** 6 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- **Fix:** Switched the deadline calculation to use a monotonic clock
- **Fix Details:** PR #3771 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
- **Context Note:** Same corner of billing/invoice_totals.py as earlier off-by-one cent work; context carried over

---

**OCCASION 2: 2026-08-10**
- **Trigger:** Problem appeared only for users in negative UTC offset timezones
- **Root Cause:** Error swallowed by bare except clause
- **Measured Outcome:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 36 days running
- **Fix:** Narrowed the exception handler and allowed the failure to propagate
- **Fix Details:** PR #6833 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-3
- **Test Coverage:** tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py
- **Stack:** Python"}
